title: 凯尔·羽毛书签
description: 金白天使凯尔收拢层叠翅膀，坐着夹好一枚羽毛书签，双剑安全陈列。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Kayle is an adult winged armored woman with long pale hair, a gold crested helmet, luminous eyes, and layered pale golden feathered wings. Preserve her radiant knight silhouette with fully covering gold-white armor, opaque underlayers, gauntlets, and boots. Her paired swords rest safely in a separate stand or remain sheathed, and the wings fold neatly instead of spreading in a battle pose.
art_direction.scene: She sits on a wide window bench and places a simple feather bookmark between the blank pages of a small book. One wing curves around the bench without hiding her hands. A little lamp and a closed cushion basket suggest a restful room, with no scripture text, combat light, or heroic battlefield background.
art_direction.palette: pale gold, feather ivory, soft lavender, warm blue
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
